giver.natural_en: Kneeling between the partner's raised legs on the right side of the frame, leaning forward over the partner and gripping both hips while looking down.

natural_en: Full-body side view of a leg lock: the receiver lies on her back on the left with legs raised and locked around the giver's waist, while the giver kneels between the legs on the right, leaning forward and gripping the hips.
prompt_zh: 側面全身腿鎖纏腰：承受方居左仰躺，雙腿抬起纏住施與方腰部、腳踝在背後交扣；施與方居右跪於腿間，前傾雙手扶胯。

titlezh: 深折疊壓制 mating press・蹲姿上位全身

receiver.label_zh: 承受方（仰躺深折疊）
receiver.natural_en: Lying on the back on the left side of the frame with both legs folded up and pressed to the sides of the upper body, knees bent high, looking up.

giver.natural_en: Squatting directly above the partner on the right side of the frame, body upright and weight pressing down, leaning forward with both hands holding the partner's legs, looking down.

title_zh: 深折疊壓制 mating press・蹲姿上位全身
natural_en: Full-body side view of a mating press: the receiver lies on the back on the left with legs folded up to the sides of the upper body, while the giver squats above on the right and presses down with the full body weight.
prompt_zh: 側面全身深折疊壓制：承受方居左仰躺、雙腿屈起壓到上半身兩側；施與方居右蹲在其上方，全身重量往下壓、雙手扶腿。

title_zh: 抬腿深壓 folded・側臥屈膝全身

receiver.label_zh: 承受方（側臥屈膝）
receiver.natural_en: Lying on the side on the left side of the frame with both knees drawn up toward the chest, legs folded close to the body, looking toward the partner.

giver.natural_en: Kneeling beside the partner's hips on the right side of the frame, leaning forward and gripping the partner's hips, looking down.

natural_en: Full-body side view of a folded side-lying position: the receiver lies on the side on the left with both knees drawn up to the chest, while the giver kneels at the hips on the right, leaning forward and holding the hips.
prompt_zh: 側面全身抬腿深壓：承受方居左側臥、雙膝收到胸前；施與方居右在其臀側跪姿進入、前傾扶胯。

title_zh: 正向直立跨坐 upright straddle・跪坐對面全身

receiver.label_zh: 承受方（面對面直立跨坐）
receiver.natural_en: Facing the partner on the left side of the frame, sitting upright and straddling the partner's thighs with both arms around the partner's neck, looking at the partner.

giver.label_zh: 施與方（跪坐腳跟上身直立）
giver.natural_en: Kneeling upright on the heels on the right side of the frame with the torso straight, both hands holding the partner's hips, looking at the partner.

natural_en: Full-body side view of an upright straddle: the giver kneels upright on the heels on the right with a straight torso, while the receiver faces the giver on the left, sitting upright and straddling the giver's thighs with arms around the neck.
prompt_zh: 側面全身正向直立跨坐：施與方居右跪坐在自己腳跟上、上身直立；承受方居左面對面直立跨坐在其大腿上、雙臂環頸。

title_zh: 反向直立跨坐 reverse upright straddle・跪立背向全身

receiver.label_zh: 承受方（背對跨坐前傾）
receiver.natural_en: With the back turned to the partner on the left side of the frame, sitting upright and straddling the partner's legs, torso leaning forward with both hands braced on the own knees, looking down.

giver.natural_en: Kneeling upright on the right side of the frame with the torso straight, both hands holding the partner's hips, looking toward the partner's back.

natural_en: Full-body side view of a reverse upright straddle: the giver kneels upright on the right with a straight torso, while the receiver sits on the left with the back turned, straddling the giver's legs and leaning forward with hands braced on the own knees.
prompt_zh: 側面全身反向直立跨坐：施與方居右跪立、上身直立；承受方居左背對施與方跨坐在其腿上，上身前傾、雙手撐在自己膝上。
